sceneConcept: A provisional design for a thirty-four-year-old Chinese community police officer stands alone against a transparent background. Short neat black hair, brown eyes and a calm attentive half-smile make her approachable. She wears a plain navy community-policing work jacket without visible unit marks over a white collared shirt, straight navy trousers, a simple belt and black flat shoes. One plain clipboard rests against her left side with blank forms facing inward, and one compact radio sits in a jacket pocket. Soft even frontal studio light keeps her a patient grassroots procedural contact rather than a tactical officer.
